Container.Name: BaconBS
Container.Overview:
A bulletin board system for Meshtastic and MeshCore mesh radio networks: bulletins, mail, channel directories, JS8Call gateway, Zork, and an admin web GUI.
Nodes replicate to each other over the radio itself or over MQTT, so several boards can share one set of bulletins and mail without any of them being a central server.
A radio is optional. Attach a USB companion radio with the Device setting below, point the BBS at a networked Meshtastic node over TCP, or run it MQTT-only to mirror another node's content. Configuration after first start happens entirely in the web GUI.
First login is admin / change-me unless you set the username and password variables below. Change it before exposing the port beyond your LAN.

Config.Name: Web GUI Port
Config.Description: Port for the admin web GUI.

Config.Name: Config and Data
Config.Description: Holds config.ini, the bulletins database, MQTT certificates and downloaded Zork story files. Everything that must survive an update lives here.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User id the BBS runs as. Unraid's default is 99 (nobody).

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group id the BBS runs as. Unraid's default is 100 (users).

Config.Name: TZ
Config.Description: Timezone, so timestamps on bulletins and mail read correctly.

Config.Name: Admin Username
Config.Description: Web GUI username. Leave blank to use whatever is in config.ini (admin by default).

Config.Name: Admin Password
Config.Description: Web GUI password. Leave blank to use whatever is in config.ini (change-me by default). Set this before the port leaves your LAN.

Config.Name: USB Radio
Config.Description: A USB-attached Meshtastic or MeshCore companion radio. Delete this entry if the radio is on the network over TCP, or if this node syncs over MQTT only. Unraid usually needs the /dev/serial/by-id/... path instead, since ttyUSB numbering changes on replug.
